sections.title: 11.4 APB access behavior of the CSR
22. References used to shape this template

REQ-FUNC-001.statement: The device shall reset its function address to 0, shall hold a 7-bit programmable address, and shall ignore any token whose address or endpoint field does not match an initialized endpoint.

REQ-FUNC-002.statement: The controller shall decode the full PID field and shall ignore every packet whose PID check bits are not the one's complement of the PID bits or whose PID is undefined; a device shall not respond to a valid PID for a transaction type or direction it does not support.

REQ-FUNC-003.statement: The controller shall compute CRC5 (polynomial X^5+X^2+1, residual 01100B) over token ADDR and ENDP or SOF frame number and CRC16 (polynomial X^16+X^15+X^2+1, residual 1000000000001101B) over the data field, seeded with all ones, before bit stuffing and after bit unstuffing, and shall ignore the protected fields of a packet with a failed CRC.

REQ-FUNC-004.statement: The controller shall keep data-toggle sequence bits per endpoint and direction, shall accept the DATA0 data stage of a SETUP transaction, return ACK and set its sequence bit so that host and device sequence bits are equal at the end of the SETUP, and shall retry with the same toggle when no handshake is received.

REQ-FUNC-005.statement: A high-speed device bulk or control OUT endpoint shall answer PING with ACK or NAK and shall answer OUT data with NYET when it accepts the data but cannot accept another maximum packet.

REQ-FUNC-006.statement: A device shall wait at least 8 bit times in high-speed (2 bit times in full-speed) after a received packet and shall start its response within 192 bit times (6.5 bit times full-speed, detachable cable).

REQ-FUNC-007.statement: Endpoint 0 shall always be present as a control endpoint, and the build parameter shall select the number of additional endpoints.

REQ-FUNC-008.statement: The data field shall be 0 to 1024 bytes in integral bytes; in low-speed the data payload shall not exceed 8 bytes.

REQ-FUNC-009.statement: The controller shall support up to three transactions per microframe for high-bandwidth isochronous endpoints using the DATA2, DATA1, DATA0 and MDATA PIDs.

REQ-FUNC-010.statement: The host shall transmit an SOF packet every 1.00 ms +/- 0.0005 ms in full-speed and every 125 us +/- 0.0625 us in high-speed, with an 11-bit frame number that rolls over after 7FFH and repeats eight times in high-speed.

REQ-FUNC-011.statement: The host root port shall drive reset for at least 50 ms in total, with each SE0 assertion at least 10 ms and gaps shorter than 3 ms, and shall allow 10 ms reset recovery before the first request.

REQ-FUNC-012.statement: The host shall run the high-speed detection handshake: detect the device Chirp K for at least 2.5 us, start the alternating Chirp K and Chirp J within 100 us of the end of the device chirp, hold each chirp 40 to 60 us, and end the sequence 100 to 500 us before reset end.

REQ-FUNC-013.statement: A high-speed capable device shall send Chirp K for 1.0 to 7.0 ms starting from reset time T0, shall move to the high-speed Default state within 500 us of detecting K-J-K-J-K-J, and shall return to full-speed Default if the sequence is not seen 1.0 to 2.5 ms after its own chirp.

REQ-FUNC-014.statement: After receiving a packet the host shall wait at least 8 bit times in high-speed before transmitting, shall keep at least 88 bit times between its own back-to-back packets and at most 192 bit times for a response; in full-speed and low-speed the host shall provide at least 2 bit times of J and at most 7.5 bit times for a response.

REQ-FUNC-015.statement: The host shall schedule the periodic (isochronous and interrupt) channels of a (micro)frame before the non-periodic channels and shall not start a transaction that cannot finish before the next SOF.

REQ-FUNC-016.statement: The host shall detect disconnect and connect in full-speed and low-speed by SE0 or non-SE0 for 2.5 us and in high-speed by the PHY HostDisconnect indication evaluated at each SOF, and shall switch to full-speed on a high-speed disconnect.

REQ-FUNC-017.statement: When PARA_USB2_SPLIT_EN = 1 the host shall issue start-split and complete-split transactions with the SPLIT token (PID 1000B), shall accept NYET and the ERR handshake from the hub, and shall use the UTMI+ level 3 preamble path for low-speed devices behind a hub.

REQ-FUNC-018.statement: A device shall enter suspend after more than 3.0 ms of constant idle and shall draw suspend current within 10 ms of bus inactivity; a high-speed device shall revert to full-speed no later than 3.125 ms after the start of idle and sample the line 100 to 875 us after reversion.

REQ-FUNC-019.statement: A device with remote wakeup enabled shall wait until the bus has been idle for 5 ms before driving resume and shall drive resume for 1 to 15 ms.

REQ-FUNC-020.statement: The host shall drive resume for at least 20 ms, end it with a low-speed EOP when the port was in low-speed or full-speed or with a transition to high-speed idle when it was in high-speed, and shall send SOF within 3 ms afterward.

REQ-FUNC-021.statement: When PARA_USB2_LPM_EN = 1 the controller shall decode the EXT token (PID 0000B) followed by the LPM token (SubPID 0011B) with bmAttributes bLinkState, HIRD and bRemoteWake, and shall answer with a handshake; as host it shall issue the LPM transaction.

REQ-FUNC-022.statement: The controller shall support Test_SE0_NAK, Test_J, Test_K and Test_Packet on command, shall transmit the test packet of REF-001 section 7.1.20 repeatedly until the exit action, and in Test_SE0_NAK shall answer IN tokens with a valid CRC with NAK.

REQ-FUNC-023.statement: In dual-role builds the controller shall act as host when the ID indication is mini-A, as device when it is mini-B, shall change role only after session end and detach, and shall let a CSR field override the PHY indication.

REQ-FUNC-024.statement: A device shall come out of reset in high-speed only when the chirp handshake succeeds and otherwise in full-speed.

REQ-FUNC-025.statement: The controller shall treat the loss of an expected response as a transaction error after the bus turn-around time and shall wait the full turn-around time before the next token when it signals an error by timeout.

REQ-FUNC-026.statement: The FIFO RAM shall be one memory that software divides into receive, transmit and host-channel regions through the CSR.

REQ-FUNC-027.statement: The FIFO manager shall never let the packet engine read data that was not written or overwrite unread data, and shall answer NAK (device) or defer the channel (host) when no space or data exists.

REQ-FUNC-028.statement: The number of device endpoints and host channels shall follow PARA_USB2_NUM_EP and PARA_USB2_NUM_HC, and unused logic shall be absent.

REQ-FUNC-029.statement: When PARA_USB2_DBUF_EN = 1 and the dbuf field of an endpoint or channel is 1, the FIFO manager shall split its region into two packet buffers, shall fill or drain one while the bus side uses the other, shall swap them at the end of each packet, and shall report the buffer in use in buf_cur.

REQ-FUNC-030.statement: With zlp_en = 1 an IN endpoint or OUT channel shall send one zero-length packet after the last full packet when the transfer size is a non-zero multiple of the maximum packet size.

REQ-FUNC-031.statement: With short_end = 1 an OUT endpoint or IN channel shall end the transfer at the first packet whose payload is shorter than the maximum packet size or is zero length, set the done flag, and leave the number of bytes not received in xsize.

REQ-FUNC-032.statement: With poll_en = 1 a host channel shall issue its transaction once every interval microframes (high-speed) or frames (full-speed and low-speed), shall retry a NAK or NYET in the next interval, shall re-arm itself after a completed transfer when poll_rep = 1, and shall set poll_miss when the previous packet was not consumed at the next interval.

REQ-FUNC-033.statement: The controller shall set iso_inc in the endpoint or channel interrupt register and in the global interrupt register when an isochronous IN token finds no data ready, when a received isochronous packet has an error, or when a host isochronous transfer is not done in its scheduled microframe; no retry shall be made.

REQ-FUNC-034.statement: With oc_en = 1 the controller shall drop o_vbus_pwr_en and o_utmi_drvvbus within 2 CLK-BUS cycles after i_ovrcur_n has been low for 16 consecutive CLK-BUS cycles, shall set ocur and oc_act, shall leave the port in the power-off state, and shall restore power only after software clears ocur and writes vbus_drv again.

REQ-FUNC-035.statement: With lpbk = 1 the link shall feed its transmitted bytes into its own receiver, isolate the PHY pins in the idle state of section 6.2, and count good and bad packets in u2_lpbk_sts.

REQ-FUNC-036.statement: When PARA_USB2_SG_EN = 1 and sg_mode = 1 the AXI4 master DMA shall treat the address register of an endpoint or channel as the head of a descriptor list, shall process the 8-byte descriptors of section 9 in order until the last descriptor, shall write back the status and the number of bytes not transferred, and shall raise an interrupt only when ioc is set or the list ends or an error occurs.

REQ-IF-001.statement: The UTMI+ wrapper shall implement the link side of UTMI+ Revision 1.0 at the level the role needs: level 0 for device, level 1 for host high-speed and full-speed, level 2 for low-speed, level 3 for split.

REQ-IF-002.statement: The UTMI+ data width shall follow PARA_USB2_UTMI_W (8 or 16 bits) with CLK-PHY of 60 MHz or 30 MHz, and the link shall use LineState only after the PHY filtering of Table 1.

REQ-IF-003.statement: The ULPI wrapper shall implement the link side of ULPI Revision 1.1 in 8-bit synchronous mode: TX CMD and RX CMD bytes, dir, nxt and stp handshake, register read and write commands, and the PHY-supplied 60 MHz clock.

REQ-IF-004.statement: The ULPI wrapper shall convert ULPI to the internal UTMI+-style stream so that the response time limits of REQ-FUNC-006 and REQ-FUNC-014 hold including the PHY pipeline delay.

REQ-IF-005.statement: The CSR shall be an APB4 completer with the behavior of section 11.4.

REQ-IF-006.statement: The AXI4 master DMA shall issue only INCR bursts of at most 16 beats that do not cross a 4 KB boundary, shall use only full-width aligned beats, and shall report BRESP and RRESP errors in the interrupt status.

REQ-IF-007.statement: The AXI4 slave port shall give access to the FIFO region windows with FIXED and INCR bursts of at most 16 beats and shall respond SLVERR to an access outside the windows.

REQ-IF-008.statement: `o_int_usb` shall be a level output that is high while any enabled interrupt status bit is set and shall be registered in CLK-BUS.

REQ-IF-009.statement: For each DMA channel `o_dma_req` shall rise when the mapped FIFO crosses its threshold, shall stay high until the DMA controller finishes the burst, and `i_dma_ack` shall be a one-cycle pulse per burst.

REQ-IF-010.statement: `i_ovrcur_n` shall be an asynchronous active-low input synchronized and filtered in CLK-BUS (CDC-006), and `o_vbus_pwr_en` shall be a registered output of CLK-BUS that is 0 whenever the port power is off.

REQ-CLK-001.statement: CLK-PHY shall be supplied by the PHY at 60 MHz (8-bit UTMI+ or ULPI) or 30 MHz (16-bit UTMI+) and the controller shall stay functional while CLK-BUS is asynchronous to it.

REQ-CLK-002.statement: Every crossing between CLK-PHY and CLK-BUS shall use a structure listed in section 7.2.

REQ-RESET-001.statement: Each domain shall assert reset asynchronously and release it synchronously, and a CSR software reset shall return all protocol state to its reset value.

REQ-RESET-002.statement: A bus reset (SE0 for more than 2.5 us in full-speed) shall wake the device from suspend and return it to the Default state.

REQ-PARAM-001.statement: Parameter values outside section 8 are configuration errors; the configuration check script and the verification wrapper shall report them, and the RTL behavior for them is undefined.

REQ-PARAM-002.statement: Host logic shall be absent when PARA_USB2_ROLE = 0, device logic shall be absent when PARA_USB2_ROLE = 1, and LPM, split, double-buffer and scatter-gather logic shall be absent when their enable is 0.

REQ-REG-001.statement: Software-visible registers shall exist only in the CSR workbook REF-005, with the version register at offset 0x0.

REQ-ERR-001.statement: The controller shall report in the interrupt status the events: PID error, CRC error, bit-stuff error, response timeout, babble, FIFO overflow or underflow, AXI error and DMA error.

REQ-ERR-002.statement: A host shall detect high-speed babble as data lines unsquelched at the end of a microframe and full-speed babble as bus activity past the end of a frame, shall stop its own transmission, and shall report the condition.

REQ-PERF-001.statement: With CLK-BUS at 100 MHz or faster the AXI4 master DMA shall sustain 24.576 MB/s of isochronous IN traffic without FIFO overflow (goal).

REQ-VER-001.statement: Verification shall include a protocol checker per interface and a USB bus functional model for each role.

REQ-DFT-001.statement: All flip-flops of both domains shall be scannable with a test-enable on every clock gate, and test mode shall override reset sources in the reset controller only.

REQ-FUNC-003.method: Directed, formal equivalence to a model
